name: change-readout
title: Change Readout
description: Shows a change both ways (₹1,200 → ₹1,500 · +₹300 · +25%), keeps percentage points apart from percent (4% → 6% is +2 pts, +50%), gives no % from a zero base or across zero, divides by |base| for negatives, adds 2.5× when a value at least doubles and marks good or bad.

meta.summary: Shows a change both as an amount and a percentage, keeping percentage points apart from percent, so changes aren't misread.
catches: Meaningless percentages from a zero base or a sign change
Misleading signs when the base is negative
"+150%" misread as 1.5×, by adding the multiple
limits: Formats and labels only; it doesn't know whether the underlying numbers are right
Good/bad depends on the goodDirection you set
a11y: Arrows and separators are aria-hidden; a text label reads "to" between values
Good or bad is stated in words, not only colour
"pts" is an <abbr> with an explanatory title
